prompts.woad: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original production animation sprite sheet for Crown & Kingdoms, a medieval isometric RTS. Input image is character-identity/art-style reference, not an edit target. Create1536x1024 PNG with genuine transparent alpha. Strict FOUR columns by FOUR rows,16cells each384x256. Exactly one complete character per cell. Fixed elevated isometric camera about30degrees, all figures facing screen RIGHT with slight front view. Consistent character proportions, scale, feet baseline and upper-left lighting throughout. Crisp hand-painted miniature, earthy medieval materials, readable dark outlines; cobalt BLUE cloth identifies team, neutral skin/leather/wood/steel. No text, cell labels, grid lines, background, floor, ground shadows, glow or scenery. Keep entire character, raised weapons, capes and feet within own cell, at least12pixels clear margin. No fragments spilling into neighbours. No detached weapons, duplicated limbs or floating effects. Upper TWO rows frames0-7: continuous eight-frame walking gait right, alternating planted/passing/extended left-right steps with natural torso/arm/cloth motion. Lower TWO rows frames8-15: eight-frame melee attack cycle:8ready guard;9draw weapon back;10raise weapon;11final windup;12full strike extended towards right;13follow through;14recover;15return ready. Actual articulated limbs and changing body poses, not whole-sprite rotations. No projectile throwing, no turntable of different facings. Subject: Woad Raider matching reference, lean muscular bare-chested adult with dark hair/beard and blue headcloth, dark tattoo markings on shoulders, blue belted short kilt, leather boots/bracers. One long wooden-handled steel battle axe held in both hands, no shield, no helmet, no armour shirt. Agile forward-leaning gait. Attack is a strong TWO-HANDED axe chop from above shoulder toward right, both hands grip shaft, single steel axehead at outer end, wood butt at other end. Every pose retains same axe length and one head. Keep tattoos dark charcoal rather than blue so only headcloth/kilt recolour. No Viking horns, no modern objects, no extra axes. Silhouette lighter and faster than shield infantry.
